page_title: NIC 3-3 LOR | Nice v Lorient 22/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+5' 3 - 3 Jean-Victor Makengo plays a neat ball into the path of Noah Cadiou (Lorient), who makes room for a shot and fires in off the right post! 3:3.
90+3' Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
90+2' Montassar Talbi (Lorient) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
90+1' Melvin Bard (Nice) has tested the patience of referee Jeremy Stinat and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+1' Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
88' The Nice players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
85' Substitution. Gabin Bernardeau (Nice) on for Tom Louchet.
84' Panos Katseris (Lorient) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
83' Wonderful movement by Nice. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
79' Lovely run from Tom Louchet (Nice). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
77' Here is a change. Theo Le Bris is going off and Olivier Pantaloni gives the last tactical orders to Panos Katseris (Lorient).
77' That's the end of the game for Bamba Dieng, who is replaced by Sambou Soumano (Lorient).
76' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
75' Lorient are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
67' 3 - 2 Goal! Bamba Dieng (Lorient) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Maxime Dupe.
67' Pablo Pagis comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient).
67' Olivier Pantaloni has decided to substitute Dermane Karim and he is replaced by Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient).
67' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
66' Claude Puel isn't happy on the touchline after referee Jeremy Stinat shows him a yellow card.
66' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Lorient!

65' Play continues despite the shouts by some Lorient players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Jeremy Stinat interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
64' Claude Puel prepares a substitution. Ali Abdi is replaced by Melvin Bard (Nice).
64' Here comes a substitution. Sofiane Diop (Nice) is given a rest as he is replaced by Hicham Boudaoui.
64' PENALTY APPEAL by Lorient, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
64' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went low to the middle of the goal, but Maxime Dupe made a easy save.
60' 3 - 1 Goal Kail Boudache (Nice)! Kail Boudache (Nice) was put through by Jonathan Clauss and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 3:1.
57' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
55' The game is interrupted now, Kojo Peprah (Nice) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
54' A pass by Pablo Pagis (Lorient) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
52' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post.
50' Igor Silva (Lorient) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
50' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) prepares to take a corner kick.
49' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
48' The corner from Pablo Pagis (Lorient) is intercepted by the defence.
48' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bamo Meite (Lorient).
46' Olivier Pantaloni is forced to make a change. Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) is unable to continue due to injury, Bamo Meite comes on.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Kevin (Nice) comes off for Kail Boudache.
46' Claude Puel has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jonathan Clauss comes on the pitch for Antoine Mendy (Nice).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' The end of the first half.
45+4' 2 - 1 Pablo Pagis (Lorient) produces an astonishing free kick which slams into the top right corner off the post and gives the goalkeeper no chance.
45+1' 2 - 0 The attempt by Mohamed-Ali Cho is blocked, but from inside of the box Tom Louchet (Nice) hits the rebound into the back of the net. He alters the score to 2:0.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Dermane Karim (Lorient) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the left post. Unlucky!
44' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Pablo Pagis (Lorient). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
40' Dermane Karim (Lorient) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
40' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
39' Lorient take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
36' Morgan Sanson (Nice) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yvon Mvogo intercepts the ball.
33' Lorient control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
31' Ball possession – 58:42.
31' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Arsene Kouassi (Lorient), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
29' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sofiane Diop (Nice) was quite harsh and Jeremy Stinat didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
28' Sofiane Diop (Nice) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
27' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
25' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle and it's Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
22' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Maxime Dupe anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
22' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
21' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Maxime Dupe comes off the line to clear the ball away.
20' Kojo Peprah (Nice) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
19' There's an opportunity for Maxime Dupe (Nice) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
18' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
18' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and Nice have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Morgan Sanson (Nice) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
15' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
15' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Lorient force a corner. They send men into the box.
14' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
14' The ball is cleared after Dermane Karim (Lorient) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Lorient win a corner kick.
12' 1 - 0 What a goal! Mohamed-Ali Cho plays it to Tom Louchet (Nice), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Yvon Mvogo low into the middle of the net. 1:0.
11' Tom Louchet (Nice) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
11' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Sofiane Diop (Nice) takes it short.
8' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
6' A pass by Sofiane Diop (Nice) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
3' Lorient enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nice will have the kick-off.
Jeremy Stinat will officiate today.
